verdict.rationale: Name.com documents a Create Domain endpoint for registering domains programmatically. It also documents an availability check with pricing, TLD price lists, HTTP Basic auth, typed SDKs and a sandbox that mirrors production, so registration can be scripted and tested in a deploy pipeline. Contact management is mentioned only in passing in the skill doc, and no nameserver-setting call appears in the evidence; only DNS record creation is shown. missing for 10: a documented nameserver set/update endpoint, a detailed contacts payload or endpoint for registration, independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.
